{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for refunded orders
df_status_counts = df['status'].value_counts()
print('Status counts:')
print(df_status_counts)

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_age_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with customer_age = -1: {sentinel_age_count}')

# Check dtype of revenue
print(f'revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}')

# Show first few rows to confirm
print(df.head())"}
